name: K-Wendel Imbiss
kurzbeschreibung:
**K-Wendel Snack Bar in Tirol** **

Your quick stop in the heart of Tirol

** Welcome to **K-Wendel Imbiss**, your go-to spot for a fast, tasty bite in the middle of Tirol! Whether you're on the move or just need a break, we’ve got you covered with classic **Tiroler** specialties and fresh, hearty meals. **

What’s on the menu?

** - **Kaiserschmarrn** – Fluffy, caramelized shreds of pancake, dusted with powdered sugar and served with apricot jam or fresh fruit. - **Leberkäse** – A **Tiroler** favorite, our juicy, spiced meatloaf is grilled to perfection and served with mustard or a fresh roll. - **Obatzda** – Creamy, tangy cheese spread with paprika and butter, perfect with pretzels or fresh bread. - **Brez’n** – Freshly baked **Tiroler** pretzels, soft and chewy, just the way you like them. - **Snacks & Sandwiches** – From crispy **Käsekrainer** (cheese-filled sausages) to hearty **Kartoffelsalat** (potato salad), we’ve got something for every craving. - **Coffee & Drinks** – A steaming cup of **Tiroler** coffee or a cold **Radler** (beer-mix) to keep you going. **

Why visit us?

** - **Quick & Easy** – No waiting in line, just grab your meal and enjoy it on the go. - **Authentic Flavors** – We use traditional recipes and fresh, local ingredients. - **Central Location** – Right in the heart of **Tirol**, perfect for travelers, hikers, or anyone exploring the region. - **Family-Friendly** – Kids love our **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Brez’n**, and adults adore the **Obatzda** and **Leberkäse**. **

Visit Us

** Find us at **[Your Location in Tirol]**. Stop by for a quick bite or a cozy meal—we’re always happy to welcome you! **

Prost und an Guadn!

**
